rationale: Author classification renewed for the implementation of accepted SPEC r2, rather than inherited from the early placeholder. Adds the third external migration path relative to v1.82.0: a local one-card picture-elements conversion with backdrop references, exact percentage positions, live labels and existing bounded Toggle/Run actions for bound/virtual markers. Includes manual/measured dimension ownership and an explicit per-element loss/count report. Standalone tooling serves administrator migration (J4); no card/backend/protocol growth, website deployment or release is included.

summary.ru: Внешний конвертер переносит карточку picture-elements: подложка ссылкой, устройства и подписи на своих местах, потери перечислены до скачивания.
summary.en: The external converter brings a picture-elements card into House Plan: backdrop reference, devices and labels at their positions, losses listed before download.
